title: Microsoft’s Majorana 2 quantum chip is also a case study for agentic AI in R&D
summary: Microsoft unveiled its Majorana 2 quantum chip featuring qubits 1000x more reliable than first generation with 20-second qubit lifetime versus industry norm in microseconds, targeting commercial quantum computing by 2029. The breakthrough showcases how Microsoft Discovery's agentic AI accelerates R&D by automating research workflows and hypothesis testing.
problem_solved: Accelerates quantum hardware development and makes complex scientific R&D more efficient through AI-driven research automation.
why_valuable: Demonstrates a successful case study where agentic AI dramatically compresses the timeline for breakthrough scientific discoveries, with Majorana 2 achieving in years what traditional methods might take decades.
